placement: Capability Packs + capability-support. The shared permission pattern (permission state, availability kept distinct from denial, user-gesture checks, permission-change watching) is mechanism every permission-sensitive pack needs, so it lives in src/capability-support/permissions.ts, which packs may import and Core never does. The geolocation pack (src/capabilities/geolocation) is the device-facing reference. Browser permission is evidence, never application authorization: the engine decides what a granted permission lets the user do. Nothing is requested at initialization. Core unchanged. The smoke runner gains permission, geolocation and host actions.
